⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Really good experience from start to finish. The staff were friendly, helpful, and easy to talk to, and the selection was solid with good quality. Everything was clean, organized, and the prices were fair. Definitely a place I’d come back to when I’m in Phuket again. 🌿

The very first thing I did after flying from Vietnam to Thailand was head straight to this wonderful shop. I bought the most amazing weed I’ve ever smoked in my life—I highly recommend it to everyone. It’s super comfortable there, with AC and all the amenities; basically, I recommend this place to everyone—it’s fantastic.

Green Garden in Kata was one of the nicest surprises of our trip. The ladies here were so welcoming from the moment we walked in — friendly, kind, and genuinely hospitable. I use the product medicinally at home so they made life a lot easier. They took the time to talk us through the different strains and what each one actually feels like, instead of just pointing at jars. That knowledge made a real difference. The prices are by far the best in the area for the quality product.
They also had a simple buy 2g, get one free deal, which was generous without feeling pushy. Nothing about the visit was rushed. They treated us like people, not just customers, and that kindness made our time in Kata feel a lot warmer.
If you’re in the area and looking for a shop that is helpful and decent, this is the one we’d go back to. Thank you to the ladies — you made our stay better.

reviews.text: Staff is amazing. Weed is very good! Good prices

My partner and I went there yesterday and liked the vibe and the stuff so we decided there to go there for a longer session to work today. All was going good but the behaviour of the staff shocked humiliated me and made me leave from there.
Today when we came there was an older woman at the counter( not the one we met yesterday, she came is later). We bought from the older woman and decided to sit there.. in between we also got a beer and a coke ( which we hadn't paid yet but we're planning to get a couple of more beers and then pay all together.) At a point, I just started arranging my stuff and started putting them in my pouch my grinder, paper and stuff ( All paid for by us) the woman suddenly makes a gesture as if she caught me red handed stealing something, when I  showed her my pouch, she suddenly  asks for payment of the beer and coke, to which I immediately apologise and made the payment ( thiking that the system is you pay as you take) then woman starts asking for the grinder, tray and all the stuff she has given, as if still trying to look for something missing that I might have put in my pouch.
Unfortunately, she got back exactly  everything that she had given us earlier. But she definitely lost respect  and a returning customer.
Wouldn't  recommend  this place unless you want to get humiliated.
